entries.title: ThunderLink 0.4.4 - FEC Separation, Shared FCX, and Cloud CAD
added: Added FCX Control as the centralized FEC regulatory and market-control system while preserving independent CAD 1 and CAD 2 community data, banking, permissions, and PostgreSQL boundaries.

Added authenticated remote FCX adapters for shared Ravenhood quotes, market history, market-maker flow, wallets, equity orders, leverage positions, trading restrictions, and community-scoped account access.

Added ThunderLink Cloud and its customer Launch PWA for community account registration, guided CAD setup, isolated Railway project and PostgreSQL provisioning, protected owner credentials, and managed deployment ownership.

Added Cloud deployment recovery and lifecycle controls, including failed-provision retry, test-community cleanup, permanent managed-CAD deletion, live Railway status reconciliation, and safe fallback branding.

Added the Release Center readiness workflow to detect deployable CAD builds, document changes and fixes, publish semantic releases, show eligible client CADs, and let each client install an update through the audited deployment path.
Added English and Spanish launcher coverage, a redesigned public product and FAQ experience, and responsive community-management screens.

Added Arma setup guidance for the required ThunderBuddies Bank Bridge and TBSRP Network Workshop mods, conditional AntiCheat guidance, and secure generation of the Railway ARMA_BRIDGE_API_KEY used by the CAD and Arma server.

Added a fully white-labeled blank Cloud CAD that uses the customer's configured community name, CAD name, colors, logo, PWA identity, accessibility labels, government seals, and service branding, with TBN - Thunder Buddies News as the Cloud newsroom.
changed: Moved FCX engine, market, leverage, investigation, promotion, and emergency authority out of the community CADs and into FCX Control with server-side authorization and audit responsibility.
Changed CAD 1 and CAD 2 Ravenhood from local market ownership to community-scoped consumers of the shared FCX market while retaining their own resident and community-account boundaries.
Changed portfolio promotional campaigns so codes are created and governed centrally by FEC administrators; CADs now only redeem eligible campaigns through FCX Control.
Changed CAD 2 owner bootstrap credentials to Railway environment variables instead of source-controlled login values.
Changed the shared margin workflow so both connected CADs use FCX leverage state and correct community/Arma context without creating duplicate market engines.
Changed index reporting to show correct FCXS and FCXV prices, per-index capitalization, and combined index market capitalization across CAD 1, CAD 2, and the blank Cloud template.

Changed the blank CAD launcher, installed PWA metadata, casino and service icons, insurance, banking, statistics, credentials, and dynamically opened workspaces to use customer branding instead of inherited Faircroft or WRLD labels.
fixed: Fixed CAD-to-FCX connection governance, live market adapter context, Arma server routing, market-maker activity display, wallet synchronization, ranged history, and scoped trading restrictions.
Fixed queued and pending FCX orders becoming stranded by repairing execution-state transitions, recovering eligible orders, and reloading resident portfolios after settlement.
Fixed Cloud CAD creation failures caused by request validation and Railway provisioning errors, and added clearer retry behavior for failed deployments.
Fixed deployed CADs remaining stuck in DEPLOYING after Railway reported a running service by reconciling the latest service deployment state.
Fixed the deployed CAD language selector layout and completed Spanish localization for dynamic management data and public launcher content.
Fixed stale or incorrect Ravenhood index metrics and restored aggregate market-cap visibility on the price desk.
Fixed legacy Faircroft and WRLD names or artwork reappearing in the blank Cloud CAD after dynamic screens opened or cached PWA assets were reused.
removed: Removed local FEC and FCX administrative control surfaces from CAD 1 and CAD 2 so community owners cannot operate the shared exchange.
Removed portfolio promotional-code issuance and retired promotional controls from both CADs.
Removed stock lottery-ticket rewards and reward-point stock purchases from the community CAD reward systems.
Removed legacy Faircroft and WRLD brand assets from the blank Cloud CAD offline cache and customer-facing fallback experience.

entries.title: RP OS 0.4.1 - Ravenhood Autonomous Exchange
added: Added the FCX Autonomous Market Engine, a persistent server-authoritative simulation layer with PostgreSQL advisory locking, isolated engine records, auditable cycles, a global kill switch, and strict separation from resident cash, resident holdings, Bank Bridge commands, and Arma records.

Added a one-click FCX deployment workflow that creates or repairs 30 operating-company listings, rebuilds the eight-company FCXS stability basket and six-company FCXV volatility basket, seeds the configured simulated-investor population, enables the scheduler, and runs the opening market cycles.

Added persistent simulated investors with configurable market personalities, capital allocation, long and short activity, liquidity behavior, sentiment, risk limits, paused personalities, and per-security participation controls.

Added FCX Engine controls for cycle speed, population, deployed capital, price floors, interval timing, order caps, human priority, market-maker spread and depth, execution budgets, panic participation, event probability, short selling, IPO uncertainty, bankruptcy, delisting, and circuit-breaker thresholds.

Added deterministic 1-day, 7-day, 30-day, and 365-day market sandboxes, manual engine cycles, investor reseeding, stock splits, cash dividends, cycle ledgers, audit summaries, and pre-deployment readiness checks.

Added an upgraded Ravenhood trade ticket that opens as a desktop modal or mobile bottom sheet with Buy and Sell modes, share or cash sizing, whole-share sliders, fractional manual entry, live commission estimates, and final order totals.

Added isolated long and short margin positions with developer-controlled leverage ceilings from 5x through 80x, collateral and liquidation previews, queued after-hours entry, market-session enforcement, server-side liquidation, and permanent open and closed position ledgers.

Added interactive Ravenhood chart navigation with wheel zoom, drag-to-pan, keyboard controls, touch gestures, reset and history controls, recorded OHLC and volume reprojection, and temporary refresh suspension while a resident examines the chart.

Added a dedicated FEC Investigator role that receives the Admin Tools launcher but is strictly scoped to the FEC Investigations workspace and receives read-only Ravenhood market access without resident trading controls.

Added FEC resident-account restrictions for share trading, leverage trading, or complete Ravenhood access, including case references, public notices, release controls, and server-side enforcement on direct and queued executions.

Added FEC security intervention tools for individual or bulk trading halts, one-click selected or full-market resumption, reversible delisting and relisting, and developer retirement of empty preserved listings.

Added the FEC Consolidated Trade Tape with searchable and sortable resident executions, flagged high-value withdrawals, resident portfolio intelligence, and net residential profit and loss views for 12-hour, 1-day, and 1-week investigation windows.

Added guarded developer actions to clear all settled Ravenhood equity cash or all resident share positions, with explicit certification, preserved historical records, and permanent reset audit ledgers.

Added FEC IPO admission review so resident filings require approval before Bank Bridge capitalization, scheduled IPOs require at least 24 hours of lead time, and developers can enforce a configurable minimum capitalization, maximum public float, and sector capacity limits.

Added controlled market-maker liquidation hunts for qualifying high-buying-power accounts with configurable thresholds, probability, intensity, maximum movement, cooldown, market-hours rules, and privacy isolation from external AI providers.

Added issuer intelligence for reported-revenue valuation changes, timestamped capitalization history, resident investors, aggregated Brokerage Account market-maker holdings, recent company executions, and expanded company performance statistics.
Added FCXV continuous-session controls so developers may permit 24-hour equity and leveraged trading in the volatility index while the rest of the exchange follows the configured market schedule.

Added market-cap ranking, per-security market capitalization, 24-hour performance labeling, average position cost, live anonymous buy and sell flow, and Brokerage Account activity throughout the Ravenhood market experience.
changed: Changed Ravenhood automation so enabling the FCX Autonomous Market Engine disables the legacy local and AI quote writers, preventing multiple automated systems from racing the same security price.

Changed market-session behavior so ordinary stocks and margin orders wait for the next opening quote while the autonomous simulation may continue building off-hours market state; FCXV can be independently configured for continuous execution.
Changed Ravenhood order entry from a persistent right-side rail into a focused, responsive trade workspace that preserves chart width and remains usable on phones and narrow browser windows.
Changed Ravenhood live refresh behavior so chart exploration and active order editing are not interrupted, erased, or repositioned by a background synchronization cycle.

Changed scheduled price programs to support one security, several selected securities, either index, or the complete operating market using percentage targets, exact target prices, immediate starts, or precise future New York times.
Changed directional automation to reach its configured Bullish or Bearish target through a live multi-step path with counter-moves instead of applying a single vertical jump or a weak market average.

Changed FEC Market Integrity into a dedicated delegated workspace and moved resident portfolios, execution surveillance, high-value withdrawal review, asset custody, listing enforcement, and account controls out of general Stock Market Settings.

Changed routine FEC halt and resume operations to direct one-click actions after selection, while destructive delisting, retirement, custody, and systemwide reset actions retain stronger authorization requirements.
Changed simulated-investor presentation from NPC and automated-market-maker wording to named Brokerage Account records while keeping resident identity and market-maker activity clearly separated.
Changed resident IPO rules to a default FC$3,000,000 minimum with developer-adjustable capitalization, float, and sector limits enforced by Railway rather than browser-only validation.

Changed issuer revenue funding to the resident-facing Report Revenue action and made completed Bank Bridge revenue settlement update the linked FCX company's recorded valuation without changing issued shares.
Changed the Ravenhood launcher and exchange header to use dedicated Ravenhood branding, higher-contrast market sidebars, a cleaner anonymous execution feed, and improved mobile layouts.
Changed FCXS and FCXV composition reporting to include resident units, simulated Brokerage Account exposure, total fund shares, current constituent weights, and complete fund capitalization.

Changed empty-market and fresh-deployment behavior to archive and clear stale live FCXS or FCXV units before rebuilding valid constituent baskets, without changing resident game-bank balances or Arma data.
fixed: Fixed leveraged-position profits and losses disappearing at close by atomically settling realized position equity back into Ravenhood buying power and recording the completed margin ledger entry.
Fixed PostgreSQL numeric rounding failures when closing leveraged positions by applying compatible numeric casts before updating resident cash.
Fixed FCX one-click deployment readiness failures caused by an invalid constituent identifier and legacy internal fund keys, including the incorrect 0-of-8 and 0-of-6 index readiness result.
Fixed stale or bankrupt securities remaining in FCXS or FCXV after operating listings were removed, and fixed empty indexes retaining live constituent or share data during a clean market launch.
Fixed FCXV simulated Brokerage Account exposure reporting zero when sell-heavy or balanced constituent flow should still contribute to the fund's derived shares and capitalization.
Fixed scheduled and overlapping price programs returning to their original baseline, activating from stale quotes, or losing their final target when another worker completed in the same cycle.
Fixed local automation getting stuck or failing against the wrong system-settings column, and made manual and sequenced cycles enter the Market Control Log before background work begins.

Fixed Gemini and DeepSeek 429 or 503 failures causing repeated requests by adding provider-aware cooldowns, ordered failover, single-attempt briefing calls, duplicate-briefing protection, and deterministic local fallback.
Fixed Company Wire publishing interpreting the announcements route segment as a numeric company identifier.
Fixed issuer revenue reporting failing because PostgreSQL could not apply FOR UPDATE to the nullable side of an outer join, and limited the lock to the required funding batch.
Fixed market liquidation-hunt eligibility using a stale default threshold instead of the saved developer policy and improved no-hunt reporting for cash-only versus leveraged exposure.
Fixed Ravenhood chart controls being cut off, compressed, or unusable on mobile and fixed chart interaction being disrupted by automatic refresh while zooming, panning, or editing an order.
Fixed oversized residential profit-and-loss values overlapping realized, unrealized, cash-equity, leverage, and resident-count fields in FEC Investigations.
Fixed FEC investigators inheriting unrelated Developer Tools sections or gaining the ability to place Ravenhood share and leverage orders.
Fixed automated volatility cycles excluding valid scheduled listings and fixed the engine reporting zero eligible listings when operating securities were available.
Fixed legacy delisted securities and inactive constituent records remaining actionable in active exchange controls after a clean FCX deployment.
removed: Removed the legacy Ravenhood quote writers from active control whenever the FCX Autonomous Market Engine owns market automation.
Removed the fixed Ravenhood order-entry sidebar that reduced chart space and became inaccessible behind narrow browser edges.
Removed general resident portfolio surveillance and FEC asset-custody actions from Stock Market Settings; those records now live in the dedicated FEC Investigations workspace.
Removed trading access and unrelated Admin Tools navigation from the scoped FEC Investigator role.
Removed the typed-reason and confirmation requirement from routine FEC trading resumptions, including selected and Resume All operations.
Removed NPC, NPC broker, and automated-liquidity wording from resident-facing issuer records in favor of Brokerage Account labels.
Removed stale empty-index constituents, invalid live index units, and retired legacy listing artifacts from active Ravenhood market views during controlled cleanup or fresh deployment.

entries.title: RP OS 0.4.0 - Capital Formation and Market Integrity
added: Added the Faircroft Office of Capital Formation, a resident-facing FCX issuer system that replaces the retired business-license application experience with direct company and IPO creation.

Added a guided IPO filing workflow for company identity, FCX ticker, sector, headquarters, investor brief, opening market capitalization, opening share price, public float, and scheduled market release.

Added authoritative IPO capitalization through the linked in-game bank and Bank Bridge, including split funding commands, settlement tracking, retry support, and creation of the FCX security only after capitalization completes.
Added resident issuer boardrooms with live company value, treasury balance, paid-in capital, authorized shares, funding progress, capital history, and controller-funded revenue contributions.

Added Company Wire publishing so resident issuers can file immediate or scheduled operating announcements, earnings notices, product releases, leadership updates, and risk notices directly into Ravenhood.
Added resident-controlled bankruptcy filings that halt issuer operations for review while preserving security, shareholder, transaction, and Company Wire history.

Added Developer Tools Business Settings for resident issuer oversight, IPO status review, and explicit assignment of an existing FCX security to a resident without reconnecting retired license records.

Added full market integration for resident-created and developer-assigned companies so scheduled movements, market administration, Gemini activity, capitalization reporting, and Ravenhood discovery recognize their securities.
Added a live anonymous Ravenhood execution tape for resident and Gemini buy or sell fills alongside the issuer Company Wire feed.
Added FEC Market Integrity asset custody with resident-specific seizure filings, a protected custody pool, supporting rationale, typed authorization, and a permanent audit ledger.
Added FEC custody dispositions for permanent forfeiture, market-cap reinvestment, and full return to the original resident without penalty.
Added a one-time official FEC clearance notice and inbox message when held assets are returned, confirming that the resident was cleared and Ravenhood buying power was restored.
Added returnable-account intelligence in FEC Market Integrity so staff can select the exact original Ravenhood account and return only its remaining held balance.
Added persistent FEC return totals and cleared-return entries to the Market Integrity ledger for complete post-disposition accountability.
Added exact-time Ravenhood price programs so developers can stage a single security, an index, a selected group, or the operating market for a future New York execution time.
Added Ravenhood Autopilot profiles for Light, Aggressive, and Extremely Volatile operation with adjustable cycle timing and minimum-to-maximum fluctuation boundaries.
Added independent Gemini market reviews with configurable timing, provider status, last-success reporting, and audited changes layered over the continuous local volatility engine.
Added selectable Local, Gemini, and DeepSeek Ravenhood movement engines with alternate-AI failover, provider cooldowns, and a deterministic local fallback when external AI is unavailable.
Added separate controls for AI review frequency and failure cooldown so developers can reduce provider rate pressure without slowing exact-time price programs.
Added numbered Ravenhood automation cycles with live provider, posture, cooldown, fallback, quote-count, and completion reporting in the Market Control Log.
changed: Changed the Business application from an approval-and-license registry into a dedicated Faircroft primary-market and issuer workspace.
Changed retired business records to remain preserved but detached from resident issuer accounts; only an explicit developer assignment can connect an existing FCX security to a resident.
Changed the issuer landing experience to the Faircroft Office of Capital Formation with a focused filing sequence, verified-capital status, portfolio intelligence, and responsive FCX branding.
Changed Ravenhood account performance wording from all-time gain or loss to current gain or loss so the label matches the displayed account position.
Changed Ravenhood market discovery to place anonymous executions and Company Wire releases beneath Market Pulse instead of crowding the horizontal quote tape.
Changed Market Integrity return processing to restore the entire remaining resident-specific custody balance in one audited clearance action.
Changed installed PWA cache identifiers and release metadata to RP OS 0.4.0 so the new issuer and FEC interfaces replace cached 0.3.1 assets.
Changed Ravenhood automation so developers choose one primary movement engine while scheduled movements remain independent and capture their live opening quote only when they activate.
Changed AI automation to try the configured alternate provider after Gemini or DeepSeek fails, then run one local profiled cycle only when both external providers are unavailable.
Changed Ravenhood Autopilot timing controls to show Local movement timing only for the local engine and AI review timing only for Gemini or DeepSeek.
fixed: Fixed the Business icon opening the retired New Application and licensing interface instead of the new IPO formation workspace.
Fixed the resident issuer entrance, company portfolio, and IPO filing content appearing off-center or visually detached on large screens.
Fixed Company Wire content being clipped behind Ravenhood's persistent left market sidebar.
Fixed low-contrast secondary labels in the Ravenhood Market Pulse, execution tape, and issuer feed.
Fixed FEC disposition selection colliding with the browser form action property and preventing the intended custody action from being submitted.
Fixed returned FEC assets lacking a resident-facing resolution state by adding targeted clearance delivery and acknowledgement tracking.
Fixed Gemini provider delays and failures pausing Ravenhood's core volatility cycle or causing immediate repeated provider requests.
Fixed future market movements appearing active before their scheduled start or using a stale quote captured when the program was created.
Fixed provider rate-limit failures immediately repeating by recording each attempt and applying a configurable Gemini or DeepSeek cooldown before another external request.
Fixed an old legacy Gemini 429 notice reappearing after the active provider error had already been cleared or replaced.
removed: Removed the retired resident-facing business approval, license-class, inspection, and application workflow from the active Business application.
Removed automatic conversion or attachment of legacy business-license records to resident FCX issuer companies.

entries.title: RP OS 0.3.1 · Markets, Protection and Platform Control
added: Added automated Ravenhood order flow so Gemini, volatility cycles, and index NAV movements contribute bounded trades, volume, VWAP, buy pressure, and sell pressure without changing resident cash or holdings.

Added two resident-tradable Ravenhood index funds: the Faircroft Stability Index (FCXS) and Faircroft Volatility Index (FCXV), both using the existing order ticket, buying power, portfolio, and transaction history.

Added automatic index classification and capped constituent weighting based on recorded volatility, quote depth, market capitalization, liquidity, and verified shareholder activity without resetting existing securities or holdings.
Added an Index Operations desk in Developer Tools with live composition, fund capitalization, company market capitalization, manual rebalancing, and per-company inclusion controls.

Added an automatic Ravenhood trading session using configurable New York open and close times, weekend trading by default, an optional weekend closure toggle, and audited Force Open, Force Closed, and Return to Schedule controls.
Added true executed-order VWAP analytics to Ravenhood, including traded volume, trade count, buy and sell flow, and buy-pressure reporting for each selected market range.
Added recorded OHLC market candles, dynamic EMA trend guidance, volatility bands, synchronized spike and drop markers, and exact hover details for price, time, volume, and VWAP.
Added persistent 1-day, 1-week, 1-month, and 1-year Ravenhood views that use recorded quote timestamps instead of rebuilding artificial history in the browser.
Added Ravenhood company administration for new listings, generated companies, shareholder exposure, invested assets, and Chapter of Bankruptcy closure controls.
Added separate Ravenhood movement controls: Stop and keep current price preserves the live quote, while Stop and restore baseline performs an explicit rollback.
Added in-app bank transaction history for supported RP OS debits, deposits, wagers, premiums, market transfers, and payouts while clearly separating unsupported in-game purchases and transfers.
Added casino-only account restrictions, bulk pending-command recovery controls, command resend actions, and clearer Bank Bridge status filtering for authorized staff.

Added configurable Lottery ticket pricing, Quick Pick purchases, rollover jackpots, expanded purchase allowances, pending-ticket controls, and split payouts for awards above the per-command bridge limit.

Added Faircroft Continuity plan terms, optional everyday-loss protection, enhanced owned-property protection, stock-loss protection, manual claims, policy cancellation, and official resident insurance certificates.
Added audited emergency coverage locks that freeze each active continuity policy at its latest synchronized in-game bank balance when a State of Emergency is declared.
Added mandatory EULA, Terms of Use, Acceptable Use, and Privacy acceptance tracking for new and existing accounts with a Developer Tools compliance ledger.
changed: Changed Ravenhood chart navigation to Live, 15-minute, 1-hour, 1-day, 1-week, 1-month, and 1-year recorded windows with independently filterable close, EMA, VWAP, and volatility-band series.
Rebuilt the Ravenhood live price desk around continuous recorded market movement so authentic scheduled spikes, crashes, and recoveries remain visible at every supported range.
Expanded the Ravenhood order ticket with live share-cost, commission, and total-order estimates before execution and whole-dollar withdrawal enforcement.
Modernized the Faircroft Casino floor, game navigation, result animations, wager history, and operational controls while keeping internal return and house-performance metrics restricted to staff.
Modernized Lottery, Insurance, Statistics, Sportsbook, Banking Settings, and Developer Tools layouts for clearer navigation, mobile behavior, and faster read-only loading.
Changed Insurance claims to authorized manual review and approval, including multi-command payouts when approved compensation exceeds the Bank Bridge command limit.
Changed Continuity coverage to follow authoritative game-bank synchronization throughout the policy term, then resume live tracking after an emergency closes.
Changed RP OS command protections to limit user-originated outstanding purchases without throttling valid Bank Bridge delivery after the player becomes available.
fixed: Fixed Live and 15-minute Ravenhood OHLC candles collapsing into isolated vertical marks by connecting verified bucket opens to the preceding recorded close and preserving true high/low wicks.
Fixed ambiguous red short-range candles by using a labeled emerald-up, gold-down, and neutral-silver direction system across every market range.
Fixed the Faircroft Insurance icon failing to open after the latest policy-certificate and Stock Protection upgrade.
Fixed Ravenhood chart hover prices being clipped when inspecting a quote near the top edge of the graph.
Fixed Ravenhood fractional-share order previews rounding stock subtotal, commission, and total cost or proceeds to zero before display.
Fixed Ravenhood history flattening or hiding genuine price spikes and drops during long-range sampling.
Fixed market charts displaying disconnected vertical price bars, synthetic low-price points, and range buttons that did not retain the selected recorded period.
Fixed the Ravenhood Market Direction signal becoming oversized or obscured by persistent footer controls in full-screen layouts.
Fixed excessive read-only Developer Tools requests competing for PostgreSQL connection slots during background market, SFTP, and presence synchronization.
Fixed Lottery Scratch navigation bypassing purchase limits, stale pending tickets leaving accounts locked, and cash prizes displaying stock-code redemption instructions.
Fixed command-ledger status counters and pending-command controls not opening their matching Completed, Failed, Cancelled, or Pending records.
Fixed cancelled or failed commerce commands leaving the originating insurance, casino, lottery, or market purchase permanently reserved.
Fixed Insurance add-on confirmation prompts appearing beneath the workspace and blocking residents from modifying existing policies.
Fixed Continuity policies remaining limited to the bank balance recorded when the resident originally purchased the plan.
removed: Removed decorative browser-generated market forecasts that could disagree with recorded Ravenhood prices.
Removed resident-facing casino return multipliers, target-return figures, and scheduled-return wording reserved for authorized operations staff.
Removed automatic Insurance claim approval and payout timing in favor of documented manual decisions in Insurance Settings.

entries.title: Faircroft Commerce and Play Systems
added: Added Bank Bridge settlement for Lottery, Sportsbook, Ravenhood, and Insurance purchases using linked in-game bank balances.
Added configurable Lottery ticket prices for Weekly Pick 5, Quick Draw, and Instant Scratch purchases.
Added developer-configurable Scratch-off prize pools with randomized in-game cash rewards and audited payout commands.
Added a ten-card Scratch-off purchase cap per account with remaining allowance visibility and server-side enforcement.
Added Lottery Settings scratch activity logs showing resident, reward amount, status, and Bank Bridge settlement state.
Added Kalshi market synchronization for Faircroft Sportsbook prediction markets with readable category grouping and YES/NO pricing.
Added a redesigned Sportsbook betting center with clearer prediction questions, high-contrast odds tiles, parlay labeling, animated selections, and improved bet-slip hierarchy.
Added Insurance purchases through linked in-game funds without the legacy four-digit receipt PIN flow.
Added responsive mobile Lottery layouts that prevent desktop overflow, clipping, and unreadable number grids.
changed: Lottery scratch rewards now settle through the authoritative in-game bank instead of the retired Railway wallet credit system.
Sportsbook presentation now treats Kalshi questions as prediction markets rather than displaying them as artificial team matchups.
Lottery mobile navigation, hero content, number selection, and purchase controls now adapt to phone-width screens.
Insurance purchase instructions now explain direct Bank Bridge debit authorization and no longer instruct residents to obtain a PIN.
fixed: Fixed Scratch-off purchases bypassing the account-wide purchase limit across multiple days.
Fixed Lottery settings not exposing configurable Scratch-off reward amounts.
Fixed Sportsbook event lists being presented as one unreadable continuous feed.
Fixed mobile Lottery content overflowing horizontally and cutting off headings and controls.
Fixed Insurance purchase UI requiring a four-digit payment receipt even though the backend queues the in-game debit directly.
removed: Removed the retired Lottery Wallet daily-credit purchase path from the active Lottery settings experience.
Removed the legacy four-digit payment receipt field from Insurance policy purchases.

entries.title: RP OS 0.2.2
added: Added a persistent Ravenhood market-history ledger that records automated, Gemini-directed, scheduled, restored, and manual security prices for genuine day, week, month, and year performance views.
Added an economy-derived Faircroft Dollar purchasing-power index with FC$/USD reference, reciprocal rate, 100-FC comparison, market breadth, and an explicit RP-only non-redeemable notice.

Added Statewide Intelligence 2.0 with detailed violent and non-violent crime families, traffic-enforcement categories, active warrants and BOLOs, court disposition flow, Fire and EMS incident mix, monthly crime movement, and per-capita public-safety rates.

Added privacy-safe economic and market intelligence covering game-bank circulation, resident-held securities value, exchange assets, executed volume, market breadth and movers, public obligations, taxes, fines, housing assessed value, and the active lottery pool.

Added a controlled Developer Tools DMV car-link reset beside the identity and money migration controls, clearing resident vehicle attachments, registrations, insurance links, and stale Railway vehicle mirrors while preserving driver licenses and authoritative game-server save files.

Added the public Faircroft Statistics Bureau application with live statewide views for population, server activity, public safety, courts, Fire and EMS, housing, mobility, commerce, and economic health.

Added a privacy-enforced public statistics API that publishes only totals, averages, medians, rates, and distribution bands while withholding resident names, CIV numbers, account identifiers, and individual bank balances.

Added animated statewide intelligence views with public-safety filing classifications, violent and non-violent crime shares, court throughput, emergency clearance rates, housing occupancy, vehicle compliance, business activity, platform mix, and average tracked server time.

Added a public Server Life intelligence view using aggregate leaderboard telemetry for collective playtime, verified sessions, live participation, thirty-day activity, kills, deaths, suicides, and the community-wide combat ratio without publishing player identities.

Added a dedicated ICE undocumented-resident enforcement roster opened directly from the live undocumented count, with identity search, active-character correlation, citizenship and passport status, linked profile access, and active federal-warrant visibility.

Added a separate audited ICE warrant ledger with one-click issuance from the enforcement roster or linked ICE profile, duplicate-active-warrant protection, subject notification, probable cause, issuing officer, and character-specific identity attachment.

Added a permanent Faircroft Lottery Purchased Tickets area that keeps Weekly Pick 5 and Quick Draw lines visible after purchase, separates active tickets from completed drawings, and records selected numbers, official winning numbers, purchase cost, draw time, winner or non-winner status, and awarded prize value.
Added a developer-only Account Deletion Command dashboard with resident search, protected-account status, linked-record impact previews, typed confirmation, and permanent deletion authorization.

Added a dedicated developer-only Account Deletion directory endpoint that searches by resident name, email, CIV number, account ID, linked Arma identity, or linked player name without arming a deletion.

Added a non-editable account deletion evidence ledger that preserves the deleted identity snapshot, linked Arma identity, reason, affected-record totals, authorizing developer, and timestamp after the account is removed.
Added the Faircroft Lottery Wallet with a configurable recurring $10 daily play credit that is isolated from game-bank currency and carries forward for future tickets.
Added resident-selected Weekly Pick 5 tickets with five unique numbers from 1 through 49, exact-match official drawings, permanent ticket ledgers, and configurable per-line pricing.
Added frequent Quick Draw rounds with resident-selected three-digit lines, configurable scheduling, per-round purchase limits, exact-match results, and automatic Lottery Wallet prizes.
Added wallet-funded Faircroft Instant Scratch purchases while preserving the physical scratch-to-reveal experience and single-use Ravenhood cash or stock reward codes.

Added interactive Faircroft Instant Scratch tickets that residents physically clear with a pointer or finger to reveal a single-use Ravenhood cash or stock reward code, with every generated code retained in Stock Market Settings for staff audit.
Added a server-authoritative Faircroft Lottery attendance engine that reads the live Anti-Cheat player roster and adjusts the prize pool by elapsed seconds using the verified online-player count.

Added Developer Tools Lottery controls for enabling player-driven pool movement, selecting increase or decrease behavior, setting the per-player per-minute rate, viewing live per-second and per-minute velocity, and auditing recent timed accruals.

Added direct MyFaircroft property-tax bill payment using the same unassigned, audited four-digit receipt PIN authority used for fines, business taxes, and Ravenhood, with paid receipts contributing to the Faircroft Lottery fund.

Added Faircroft Realty Group, a public full-screen property market where residents can explore synchronized homes for sale or rent, review editorial property presentations and photography, select an exact character, and submit verified auction bids.

Added the private Realty Dash application and Realty Owner role, with a brokerage command center connected only to that owner's linked owned and rented property records, listing drafts, market publication, live offer oversight, and closing archives.

Added character-specific Faircroft Realty closings that record winning sale bidders as deed holders and winning rental bidders as tenants in an audited RP OS ownership overlay without writing into protected game-server property files.
Added role-aware Admin Tools access with developer-controlled switches for selectively delegating restricted operational sections to administrators.
Added server-enforced Admin Tools section authorization so locked administrator sections cannot be accessed by calling their protected endpoints directly.

Added Faircroft Housing Conditions intelligence with live availability, occupancy, demand coverage, estimated unhoused-account rate, additional-home requirements, and market-pressure status derived from verified accounts and synchronized TBS ownership records.

Added a Developer Tools Property Tax command with exact-property 14% assessments, owner portfolios, source-value projections, unpaid balances, permanent resident notices, and staff auditing without writing into the game property files.

Added exact-property tax liens, required lien-before-seizure enforcement, release actions, and business-tax property enforcement restricted to synchronized properties owned by the registered business owner.

Added Business Tax & License Enforcement inside Developer Tools Settlement Operations, with government-wide unpaid, accrued, and weekly tax totals plus exact-license suspension, revocation, and restoration controls.
Added permanent tax-enforcement violations, owner notifications, required enforcement reasons, and staff audit records for every business-license action.

Added Faircroft Continuity Protection with monthly $3,500, $4,250, and $5,000 policy tiers covering 50%, 70%, or 90% of a verified protected game-bank balance after an authorized server reset or wipe.

Added resident wipe-claim filing with exact character and policy ownership, verified bank snapshots, calculated recovery values, duplicate-review protection, and a persistent pending-to-completed claim ledger.

Added a Developer Tools Insurance Claims command center with open-exposure totals, resident and character intelligence, protected-balance verification, approval and denial decisions, paid-compensation confirmation, resident notifications, and permanent staff auditing.

Added the Faircroft Insurance Authority application with character-specific vehicle, property, life, business, and general policies, tiered coverage questionnaires, universal four-digit receipt PIN settlement, and official expiring digital insurance certificates.

Added the Faircroft Gang Network with character-bound gang creation and membership, secure four-digit recruitment PINs, private leader command, member ranks, roster control, and strict prevention of cross-character membership leakage.

Added Developer Tools Gang Settings with creation and membership limits, complete organization and recruitment-PIN ledgers, roster governance, member locks, organization shutdown controls, and hidden gang-leader role intelligence.

Added ICE MDT Gang Intelligence with active affiliation flags, exact character identities, matched CIV and passport records, citizenship status, search, and one-click access to the linked CAD intelligence profile.

Fixed vehicle migration account isolation by correlating imported vehicles only to the exact stable Arma identity linked to the authenticated Faircroft account; unresolved legacy imports remain quarantined until ownership is confirmed.

Added Developer Tools Ravenhood promotional campaigns under Active Campaigns, with generated or custom codes, expiration windows, redemption inventories, pause and resume controls, and a permanent claimant audit ledger.

fixed: Fixed opened Indeed Admin applications being cut off at the bottom of the phone panel.

entries.title: Traffic Stop Protocol Assistant
added: Added a MDT Settings page for officer workflow controls.
Added a skippable Traffic Stop Assistant that walks officers through RP stop protocol from observation through documentation.
Added an Initiate Traffic Stop button in MDT Settings and the MDT watch panel.
Added a device-level setting to keep the traffic stop assistant available or pause it on that officer device.
changed: Traffic stop guidance now appears as a terminal-style overlay with progress, step navigation, next/back controls, finish, and skip actions.
The MDT watch panel now exposes traffic stop protocol access alongside Dispatch, Messages, Write Ticket, and NYS Codes.

entries.title: Officer MDT Visual Overhaul
added: Added a new law/CID MDT terminal skin with a connected command layout instead of stacked widget panels.
Added a MDT status line showing callsign, active workspace, and terminal time.
Added numbered MDT navigation controls for faster officer orientation.
changed: Reworked the officer/CID MDT shell, nav rail, telemetry strip, ticket writer, code cards, and watch panel to feel more like one modern CAD terminal.
Reduced repeated boxed-card styling across the MDT and replaced it with flatter connected panels, rail separators, and subtle command-console motion.
Added mobile-specific rules so the redesigned MDT still works with slide-out menu and watch drawers on phones.
fixed: Reduced the blocky widget look in the MDT interface while preserving the existing NCIC, ticket, BOLO, report, panic, and CID workflows.

entries.title: Indeed Admin and NYS Ticket Book
added: Added a new Indeed Admin app icon for owners, admins, and the new indeed_admin role to review department job applications.
Added the indeed_admin role to account role assignment and department application review notifications.
Added NYS VTL-style traffic, vehicle, license, insurance, equipment, and parking citation entries to the MDT citation catalog.
Added MDT ticket shortcuts for Write Ticket and NYS Codes from the watch panel and citation cards.
changed: Department application review permissions now allow the Indeed Admin role without granting full Admin account-management access.
Admin Job Apps and Indeed Admin review queues now use clearer folder-style application packets with explicit open and close controls.
The ticket writer now groups citation and criminal code dropdown options by category for faster officer selection.
fixed: Improved application packet opening behavior in the Admin Job Apps layout.
Reduced officer ticket friction by making citation writing and NYS code browsing accessible from more MDT screens.

entries.title: Court Citation Flow and Application Cleanup
added: Court now clearly labels MDT-issued citations as court cases in the docket.
Users with issued citations can open Court to pay or contest even if their civilian verification is still pending.
Court now shows active and previous docket counts in a dedicated citation/case header.
changed: Officer court dockets now use the full law-service role list, including Sheriff, Police, State Police, CID, and IU roles.
Admin Job Apps now render as compact expandable application folders instead of open review forms in a long wall.
The Jobs app now uses collapsible application packets and a compact My Application Files section.
fixed: Fixed citations not appearing for officers whose role was a department role instead of the generic LEO role.
Fixed unverified defendants being unable to access Court when they already had a citation to resolve.
Reduced Admin and Jobs panel clutter from stacked application widgets.

entries.title: Application Review Queues
added: Added an Admin Job Apps panel where owners/admins can see department applications without relying on inbox messages.
Admins can now mark department applications under review, approve them, deny them, or close them from the Admin panel.
Approved department applications now verify the account, add the requested department role, and set the agency when blank.
Admin accounts now receive Business Registry staff view access for reviewing business applications.
changed: Business Registry review now uses compact application folders with status filters instead of one long expanded list.
Business Registry recent decisions now render as dedicated registry action rows.
fixed: Fixed admins not having a visible queue for submitted job/department applications.
Reduced business application review wall clutter by hiding full plans, funding, and forms inside expandable folders.

entries.title: Referral Cash Tickets
added: Added an Admin Referral Tickets panel where owners/admins can review pending referral payouts.
Referral payouts are now held as $50,000 cash tickets until an owner/admin manually deposits them.
Admins and owners now receive inbox notifications when a referral payout ticket is created.
Referral ticket deposits create transaction history and notify the referrer after payout.
changed: Referral registration no longer auto-deposits cash into the referrer's wallet.
Profile referral stats now separate pending referral tickets from deposited referral cash.

entries.title: Referral Program
added: Added a referral code to every user profile.
New users can enter a referral code during registration.
When a referral code is used, the code owner receives a $50,000 in-game cash credit.
Profile now shows referral stats, total referral cash earned, recent referral credits, and a Copy Code button.
changed: Admin account search now also finds accounts by referral code.
Referral bonuses are recorded in the transaction ledger and message inbox.

entries.title: Admin Account Search
added: Added a live account search bar to the Admin Users panel.
Admins and owners can search accounts by name, email, CIV number, Arma ID, car entry code, callsign, agency, active character, role, or verification status.
changed: Admin account results now show a live match count and can be cleared with one button.

entries.title: Faircroft Treasury and Bank Opening
added: Added a Faircroft Treasury phone app for verified users.
Players can submit server wipe compensation requests with screenshot proof uploads.
Players without proof can check the no-proof bypass to request the standard $75,000 stimulus check.
Owner/admin review tools can approve Treasury requests and deposit approved funds directly into the player bank.
Bank now includes owner/admin Treasury deposit controls and a compensation ledger showing who has been paid.
changed: Bank is now unlocked for verified users instead of being marked coming soon.
Treasury deposits now create bank transaction records and player messages for tracking.

entries.title: Civilian Getting Started Guide
added: Added a Getting Started phone app icon for civilians.
Getting Started includes starter route steps for buying a used car, Dirty Pond money grinding, bag upgrades, Town Hall IL license, and mining prep.
Added map screenshots for Used Cars, Dirty Pond, Bag Store, Town Hall, and Hardware Store.
changed: PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the new guide and map assets.

entries.title: MDT Quick Rail Placement
changed: MDT quick action buttons now stay mobile-only as a bottom action strip.
fixed: Fixed the floating Dispatch/Messages/Watch rail covering the desktop MDT watch panel.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the corrected rail placement.

entries.title: Dispatch Button Controls
added: Dispatch selected-call updates now use direct status buttons instead of status dropdowns.
Added a Close Ticket button that closes the CAD call and moves it off the active dashboard into Past Calls.
changed: Dispatch priority updates now use button controls for standard, elevated, and critical priority.
Closed or cleared calls no longer remain pinned as the selected active dashboard call unless opened from Past Calls.
fixed: Fixed closed dispatch tickets staying visible in the main active call workspace after status changes.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the new dispatch controls.

entries.title: MDT Dispatch Rail and Callsign Fix
added: Added a floating MDT quick rail with Dispatch, Messages, and Watch actions for officers.
Department users now get a required callsign popup so dispatch can identify and assign them.
Dispatch access now recognizes Sheriff, Police, State Police, Metro Police Chief, and State Police Commander roles.
changed: Opening Dispatch or Messages from the MDT now returns officers back to the MDT when closed.
PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the fixed MDT and dispatch bundle.
fixed: Fixed a JavaScript parse error in the dispatch NCIC lookup binding that could leave the app stuck on the loading screen.
Fixed the MDT workspace referencing an undefined command variable when opening the MDT.
Updated the service worker cache to stop serving the older boot loader and stale asset URLs.

entries.title: Dispatch Past Calls Archive
added: Moved completed dispatch calls out of the main dispatch queue and into a dedicated Past Calls modal.
Added a Past Calls button that opens full-call summaries with department, times, notes, and unit counts.
Allowed opening any past call directly into CAD for review and follow-up.
changed: Main dispatch queue now stays focused on active calls while keeping historical calls available via button-open detail panel.

entries.title: Dispatch Control Center
added: Added a Dispatch app for dispatcher and owner roles.
Dispatch now opens as a full control-center CAD dashboard with call queue, call intake, selected call controls, unit assignment, and scene notes.
Dispatchers can create CAD calls, attach and detach units, update call status and priority, and post notes for active scenes.
changed: 911/Panic calls now carry call type, priority, and updated timestamps for dispatcher tracking.
PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the Dispatch app.

entries.title: Tiny OS Version Footer
added: Added a small RP OS version footer to the phone-style PWA shell.
changed: PWA cache versioning was bumped so installed devices load the footer update.

entries.title: MDT BOLO Load Guard
changed: MDT data loading now treats the BOLO feed as optional during startup so the rest of the MDT can still render if Railway is not serving the new BOLO endpoint yet.
PWA cache versioning was bumped again to force installed devices to request the newest MDT JavaScript.
fixed: A missing or stale BOLO API route can no longer block the MDT screen from loading its updated navigation.

entries.title: MDT BOLO Board
added: Added a separate BOLO tab inside the LEO/CID MDT for all active officer lookouts.
Officers can broadcast BOLOs with target details, vehicle notes, plate, last seen area, caution level, and reason.
The MDT watch panel now previews active BOLOs for faster officer awareness.
changed: MDT stat strips now include active BOLO counts.
PWA cache versioning was bumped again so installed devices pull the System Update Lockdown screen and BOLO board after deployment.
fixed: BOLOs now persist in the database and can be cleared or cancelled instead of living only as temporary screen content.

entries.title: System Update Lockdown
added: Owner System Settings now includes a System Update Lockdown mode with a custom lockdown message.
When lockdown is enabled, users see a Software Update-style phone screen.
Driver License and LEO MDT remain available during lockdown, with owner System controls preserved so lockdown can be disabled.
changed: DMV opens directly to the Driver License page during update lockdown.
The app catalog is restricted during lockdown so unavailable apps cannot be opened from the phone screen.
fixed: Vehicle registration and DMV vehicle updates are blocked while update lockdown is active.
PWA cache versioning now forces installed devices to load the update lockdown screen.

entries.title: Recruitment-Only Jobs
added: Jobs is now unlocked for signed-in users so civilians can submit department applications before verification.
changed: The Jobs app is now a recruitment/application portal only.
Admin overview now shows active department applications instead of passive job assignments.
fixed: Passive job apply and passive income collect endpoints now return disabled responses.
PWA cache versioning now forces installed devices to load the recruitment-only Jobs screen.
removed: Removed the Passive Income Jobs board from the Jobs app.
Removed passive income collection and daily requirement UI from Bank.
Removed passive Jobs and Markets tabs from the Admin panel.

entries.title: Law Enforcement Application Packets
added: Law enforcement department applications now use the full required questionnaire covering in-game name, Discord, age, department selection, experience, scenarios, and policy acknowledgements.
Added Metro Police Chief, State Police Commander, and CID Director command roles for department application routing.
Submitted law enforcement packets now include a reviewable answer preview in the Jobs app.
changed: Metro Police, State Police, Sheriff Office, and CID postings now save full structured application packets instead of a single short statement.
Department application messages now include the completed answers for command review.
fixed: Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the new law enforcement application form.

entries.title: Profile Car Entry Codes
added: Civilian registration now requires an in-game car entry code.
Existing users without a car entry code now get a blocking profile update popup after login until the code is saved.
Profile now includes a car entry code section where users can update their code.
MDT/NCIC searches now show the civilian car entry code on account returns and profile popups.
changed: Officers can search NCIC/DMV by car entry code in addition to name, email, CIV number, and plate.
fixed: Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the car entry code requirement.

entries.title: Department Jobs Portal and Fire MDT Mobile Cleanup
added: Jobs now opens as a department recruiting portal with tabs for State Police, Metro Police, Sheriff Office, CID, Fire Dept, EMS, and Dispatcher.
Players can submit saved department applications with a written statement from the Jobs app.
Department applications now receive application numbers and notify owner/admin accounts.
changed: The Jobs app is now unlocked for verified users instead of remaining a coming-soon app.
Passive income jobs now sit below the department recruiting board as the Civilian Work Board.
Fire MDT apparatus assignments now render as compact command cards instead of a tall desktop-style roster on phones.
Fire MDT header, status strip, and command controls have tighter mobile sizing.
fixed: Fire MDT now uses the current user's Fire Chief command role as a fallback when the overview cache reports read-only.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the Jobs portal and Fire MDT mobile cleanup.

entries.title: Fire Chief Command Access Fix
added: Fire command role handling now recognizes Fire Chief role aliases from older or display-form account records.
changed: Fire personnel lists now use the same normalized role checks as Fire command permissions.
fixed: Fixed Fire Chief accounts seeing read-only rig assignment controls instead of chief command controls.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the Fire Chief access fix.

entries.title: IA Folder File Logs
added: Internal Affairs folders now support investigator file entries tied to the selected IA record.
IA folders now include quick tools for evidence, interviews, command review, and findings.
Each IA file now has a chat-style file log showing author, entry type, body, and timestamp.
changed: Ongoing IA tools now live inside the selected IA folder instead of feeling like static page-level controls.
IA folder cards now show file entry counts in the folder rail and detail metrics.
fixed: Fixed IA investigations lacking a place for investigators to keep adding updates after the intake file was created.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the IA folder file log.

entries.title: Fire Settings Mobile Assignment Polish
added: Fire Settings now has a dedicated phone-native apparatus assignment layout.
Apparatus rows animate in as touch-friendly assignment cards inside the Fire Settings app.
changed: Fire Settings no longer uses the wide desktop roster layout inside the phone app panel.
Rig assignment fields, status selectors, notes, and save buttons now stack cleanly on mobile.
Fire Settings buttons and apparatus cards now have stronger hover and touch feedback.
fixed: Fixed Fire Settings cutting off role, status, notes, and action columns on phone screens.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the Fire Settings mobile layout.

entries.title: IA Folder Board and Interaction Polish
added: Internal Affairs now uses selectable IA folders instead of showing every IA file as one long board.
Active IA and previous IA files are separated in the folder rail.
New IA records automatically open the newly created IA folder.
changed: Only the selected IA file opens with full summary, metrics, and update controls.
MDT buttons now have stronger hover, focus, and press feedback.
MDT popups now animate in with a smoother fade and lift treatment.
fixed: Fixed Internal Affairs dumping all summaries and update forms into the same visible board.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed devices load the IA folder board and interaction polish.

entries.title: Fire MDT Roster Redesign and Account Deletion
added: Owner account panel now includes an owner-only delete account action for non-owner accounts.
Fire command rig assignments now use a dispatch roster layout with one column header row and operational apparatus rows.
changed: Fire MDT rig assignments no longer render as a grid of box-like mini forms.
Fire MDT command stats now display as a slimmer telemetry bar instead of chunky stat boxes.
Fire rig controls now use compact roster fields to reduce clutter on desktop while stacking cleanly on mobile.
fixed: Reduced the cramped visual layout shown when multiple battalion and apparatus assignments are visible at once.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed phones load the redesigned Fire MDT roster.

entries.title: Fire Command Settings
added: Fire command roles now include Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, and Fire Marshal.
Fire Settings app icon now appears for fire command users and owner accounts.
Fire Settings includes chief-level rig assignment controls using the same live data as Fire MDT.
Rig assignment options now include Battalion 1 through Battalion 5.
Rig positions now include Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, Fire Marshal, and Battalion Chief.
changed: Fire rig assignment control now unlocks for Fire Chief, Deputy Chief, Fire Marshal, and owner accounts.
Owner/admin account management can assign the new fire command roles.
Fire alert routing now includes Deputy Chief and Fire Marshal recipients.
fixed: Fixed Fire MDT rig assignments showing read-only for command users outside the original fire_chief role.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed phones load the new Fire Settings icon and expanded rig list.

entries.title: CAD After-Call Reports
added: MDT now includes a Reports tab for officers to file after-call incident reports.
Reports can link to a CAD/911 call, an involved civilian profile, call type, disposition, location, narrative, actions taken, and evidence or clip links.
Officers can mark calls as cleared, founded, unfounded, report taken, citation issued, arrest made, referred to CID, false alarm, or unable to locate.
Recent reports now appear in the MDT side watch panel for quick command review.
changed: Linked CAD calls are automatically cleared when an after-call report is filed as cleared, unfounded, false alarm, or unable to locate.
CAD report narratives preserve long-form text and line breaks for detailed officer documentation.
CID Command quick actions now include direct access to CAD Reports.
fixed: Officers now have a dedicated place to document incident outcomes instead of relying only on tickets, panic alerts, or court cases.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed MDT views load the new Reports tab.

entries.title: CID Command MDT
added: CID users now open into a dedicated CID Command MDT instead of a patrol-style MDT with only investigation tabs.
New CID Command dashboard with priority case watch, active warrant operations, intelligence feed, internal affairs queue, and quick action launchers.
CID-wide side intelligence panels for command tracker, priority cases, and warrant watch.
Warrant detail popup can now be opened from the CID Command dashboard, side watch, or Warrant Ops board.
changed: CID MDT shell now uses CID-specific navigation labels, command statistics, title treatment, and investigative visual styling.
Warrant Ops and Internal Affairs intake screens now use the same CID command-board layout as investigations.
CID case notes now store full text instead of being capped at the previous note length.
fixed: CID MDT no longer feels limited to a single Investigations tab; the whole module is now an investigative command system.
Non-CID users are safely returned to NCIC if an old session points at a CID-only tab.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed MDT views load the new CID Command MDT.

entries.title: CID Investigation Desk Redesign
added: Investigative MDT CID Investigations tab now has a redesigned command-desk case intake board.
CID investigation creation now includes a target civilian dropdown populated from all user profiles.
Target civilian selection auto-fills the target name while still allowing unlisted target aliases.
changed: CID investigation summaries now store full text instead of being capped at the previous short limit.
CID investigation intake layout now uses a larger long-form summary area and cleaner responsive mobile layout.
fixed: Removed the need for officers to type raw target CIV database IDs when opening CID investigations.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed MDT views load the redesigned CID tab.

entries.title: Character Profiles and Name Locking
added: Profile app now includes a character roster where players can create multiple RP characters.
Players can activate a saved character and the active character name becomes the profile name used across the PWA.
Profile app now includes a controlled active-name change form with a 3 changes per 3 days limit.
Admin Account pop-up now shows character count and name-change status.
changed: Existing accounts automatically receive a default character based on their current profile name.
Name-change limits are enforced by the backend instead of only being hidden in the UI.
fixed: Admins and owners can unlock a user's name changes from the Account pop-up after the limit locks them.
Updated PWA cache versioning so installed phone views load the new Profile character tools.

entries.title: DMV License Approval Countdown
added: DMV License page now shows a visible approval queue card after a driver license application is submitted.
Pending license applications now display a countdown until automatic approval.
Countdown uses the owner-configured DMV autopilot approval time from System Settings.
changed: DMV license applications refresh automatically when their approval countdown reaches zero.
DMV API now returns license autopilot settings and estimated approval times for pending applications.
fixed: Made driver license approval visible to civilians even without a separate DMV department dashboard.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the DMV countdown page replaces older cached DMV screens.

entries.title: Profile Warrants and Fire Chief Rigs
added: NCIC/DMV searches now open a civilian profile popup with attached warrant records.
Civilian profile popup now has a Warrants tab with active and previous warrant history.
Fire Chief role for command-level Fire MDT access.
Fire Chief rig builder for assigning personnel to Engine 1, Ladder 1, Truck 1, Rescue 1, and Battalion 1.
changed: CID warrant board now uses button containers and detail popups instead of showing full warrant files on the main wall.
Served, recalled, and expired warrants move out of the active warrant board and into previous warrant history.
fixed: Fixed warrants not appearing on the searched civilian profile record.
Fixed fire alerts not recognizing a dedicated Fire Chief command role.
Updated PWA cache versioning so profile warrant and Fire Chief rig changes replace older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: Issue Criminal Charge Warrants
added: Issue Criminal Charge screen now has the civilian name/CIV dropdown directly inside the Issue form.
Issue Criminal Charge screen now includes a Bypass Court section.
Bypass Court creates an active warrant linked directly to the selected account without creating a court docket case.
changed: Criminal charge submissions from the Issue screen now sign and issue an active warrant immediately.
Criminal catalog Use Charge now opens the Issue screen with that criminal charge already selected.
fixed: Fixed the criminal charge issue flow still relying on a raw CIV ID instead of the profile dropdown.
Fixed charge warrants being available in the wrong MDT area instead of the Issue Criminal Charge section.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the corrected Issue Criminal Charge screen replaces older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: Criminal Charge Warrants
added: Criminal Charges tab now includes a charge-warrant writer with civilian profile dropdown, criminal charge selector, probable cause, priority, and optional linked CID case.
Officers can sign and issue an active warrant directly from a criminal charge.
changed: Signed charge warrants now create both a court criminal charge and a linked active warrant for the selected civilian.
fixed: Criminal charges can now be tied to warrant creation instead of only appearing as catalog entries.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the Criminal Charges warrant writer replaces older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: CID Warrant Linking
added: CID warrant creation now includes a civilian profile dropdown for selecting the warrant subject by name and CIV number.
changed: Warrants now store the selected civilian profile ID with the subject name so warrant records remain linked to the correct player profile.
fixed: Fixed warrants not attaching cleanly to civilian profiles when officers only typed a subject name.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the warrant-linking form replaces older cached MDT screens.

entries.title: DMV License Autopilot
added: Driver license auto-approval system for submitted DMV license applications.
Owner-controlled DMV autopilot settings under the System app with pending and eligible license queue counts.
MDT civilian profile popup with profile and driver license tabs.
Law enforcement driver license suspension action from the MDT license tab.
changed: Driver license applications default to auto-approval after 6 minutes when DMV autopilot is enabled.
Suspended or revoked driver licenses are protected from automatic re-approval.
fixed: Added a license approval path so DMV applications no longer remain submitted forever when no admin review screen exists.
Updated PWA cache versioning so the CID investigation folder interface replaces older MDT layouts on mobile.

entries.title: System Autopilot Controls
added: Owner-only System Settings app icon.
Auto pilot verification mode for automatically verifying civilian accounts after a configurable waiting period.
System queue stats showing pending accounts and accounts eligible for auto-verification.
Fire Department MDT for fireman and EMS roles with active 911 incident tracking.
Fireman role option in account role assignment.
changed: Default auto-verification wait time starts at 120 minutes and can be adjusted by the owner.
911 emergency alerting now supports Police, Fire, and EMS department selection.
fixed: Updated PWA cache versioning so new app modules like Fire MDT load after deployment instead of using stale mobile bundles.

entries.title: Initial Roleplay PWA System
added: Mobile PWA phone dashboard with app-style icons, locked/unlocked app states, dock shortcuts, and smoother mobile OS visual styling.
Civilian registration with required Arma ID, generated six-digit CIV number, verification flow, and owner/admin account management.
Read-only Changelog app loaded from the GitHub-managed repository file.
DMV app with driver license applications, vehicle registration, plate/VIN records, insurance status, and DMV profile display.
Automatic DMV VIN generation when civilians register vehicles.
Messages app unlocked for verified users.
Admin dashboard with compact account list, account popup, role assignment, verification controls, Arma ID visibility, job settings, market caps, and owner/admin password reset.
MDT/CAD app for owner and assigned LEO/CID roles with NCIC/DMV search, invalid-return notice popup, citation writer, criminal charge writer, panic button, and active alert watch list.
Owner-only panic alert clearing from the MDT panic screen.
Separate MDT citation and criminal charge catalogs, including New York Penal Law criminal charge entries.
Court system with active/previous case tabs, defendant case view, officer case tracking, judge docket, final result display, and auto-generated court dates.
CID investigative MDT tools with investigation tracking, case notes, warrant operations, and internal affairs records.
Civilian Contracts app with anonymous open contract board, accept flow, owner read-only monitoring, and required in-game proof clip URL submission.

Business Registry app with civilian business applications, registrar review workflow, license issuance, staff inspections, violations, suspensions, revocations, weekly tax settings, reputation scores, and dedicated City Hall/economy roles.
changed: Contracts app now uses a dark web-style phone interface with first-open instructions.
Contract posting now targets RP character names only and no longer accepts email lookup.
Contracts now include target type, last-known area, briefing, and completion requirement details.
Only pure civilian accounts can post or accept contracts; owner remains monitor-only.
Home screen no longer shows pending income or tracked server minutes.
Jobs, Bank, Cash App, and Properties remain locked/coming soon while Messages is available.
Admin access no longer automatically grants MDT, CID, LEO, or judge access.
Admin account role assignment now includes business_owner, business_registrar, city_hall, and economy_manager roles for business registry access.
Business applications now show a dynamic approval progress tracker from submitted to review, interview, and final decision.
Profile now shows account details only while external linking is paused for verification.
Court tabs only appear when the user has the matching role or owner override.
MDT opens as a full law enforcement dashboard instead of staying confined to the phone panel.
Mobile MDT now uses animated Menu and Watch slide-out drawers so officers can navigate without the tabs crushing the screen.
Phone icons, dock, and home layout were restyled to feel more like an iPhone/Android app launcher.
fixed: Fixed PostgreSQL LIKE migration crash by parameterizing the traffic citation pattern.
Fixed low-contrast MDT charge dropdown styling.
Fixed NCIC/DMV search empty results by showing an official invalid-return notice with a reference number.
Fixed admin user page overload by moving account details and actions into a popup.
Fixed role leakage where admin accounts were being treated like owner accounts for MDT/CID/LEO/judge access.
Fixed panic alert workflow so owners can clear active panic hits.
Fixed mobile MDT layout collisions where navigation, watch panels, and form controls stacked into an unreadable phone view.

Added DMV credential enforcement: suspensions issue a fixed $2,500 MyFaircroft restoration fee, revoked credentials require a separate 30-question recovery examination, and restoration is blocked until the required path is complete.
removed: Removed the unlocked-home income summary card from the main screen.
Removed owner/admin edit or delete controls from the Changelog app; changelog content is developer-managed through the repository.
